The first WCA competition in Trinidad and Tobago! 🇹🇹 We welcome participants of all ages, skill levels, and nationalities.

This competition serves as the 2026 national championship for Trinidad and Tobago. Competitors who are citizens of Trinidad and Tobago are eligible for the national championship titles.
